messages:
Olivia: quick question — PR #4532 landed for structured output canary. before we flip on stricter content-type handling, can we confirm how endpoints should behave when optional fields are null vs completely absent? cc @Sam @Devon

Sam: short answer: for legacy clients we should prefer omission for missing data. for v2 clients we can accept explicit nulls, but we need the schema + SDK contract updated.

Devon: can you show a minimal example of what you mean?

Sam: sure — current behavior (older rollout):
```json
{"id": "abc", "score": 0.92}
```
new behavior allowing explicit null:
```json
{"id": "abc", "score": null, "metadata": null}
```
Clients that rely on property existence should tolerate absence; new parsers will treat null as intentionally empty.

Mira: product question — is there any UX difference we need to signal to downstream teams? e.g., should we normalize null->absent in the console or show "null"? :thinking_face:

Olivia: good call. for Console and Logs we'll render missing fields the same way (omitted) to avoid noise. But the API will allow null for v2 feature flags. rollout plan in the PR description: 10% canary, compatibility tests, then 50% then full.

schema-checker-bot: automated check: schemas/v2/response.schema.json -> warning: "metadata" property currently not allowed to be null per schema. see https://redwood.internal/schemas/v2/response.schema.json#L24

Sam: ok I'll update the JSON Schema to allow ["null", "object"] for metadata and add explicit examples. Also will add a note in SDK changelog about nullable fields.

Devon: small ask for the PR — can you add a tiny smoke test that verifies server returns omitted field for legacy clients (accept header: application/json;version=1) and returns explicit null when client sends Accept: application/json;version=2 and provides null in patch? that should catch regressions.

Olivia: perfect. I'll tag this as a code-review checklist item. @Sam can you ping when PR has tests?

Sam: will do, aiming to push tests + schema update by EOD. :thumbsup:

Mira: heads up to Integrations team — expect a short changelog entry about nullable metadata and guidance to treat missing/null as equivalent unless they rely on semantic difference.

Olivia: thanks all. putting this in the canary checklist. if anyone sees anything blocking on the tests, drop a note here. :eyes:
